jobs.description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role sits on the Risk Incubation & Systems (RIS) vertical in USRO, which investigates emerging risks, builds data and automation capabilities, and develops workflows that can scale into durable operational homes.

About the Role

As part of the Automation & Analytics function within RIS, you’ll partner with teams across USRO to support their data, analysis, measurement, and automation needs. You’ll build tools and workflows that help teams make informed decisions and improve how they operate. You’ll work with domain experts to turn judgment into testable criteria, then help take promising prototypes into reliable operation.

You will work hands-on with Trust & Safety domain experts,  investigators, operational leads, and engineers to turn ambiguous requirements into practical systems. You’ll test and document the tools and workflows you build, and agree with partner teams who will monitor and maintain them.

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.

jobs.title: SAP Close Automation Consultant, Luxembourg
jobs.description: SAP Close Automation Consultant, Luxembourg Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Luxembourg. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English. The programme We are looking for an SAP consultant to design and build an automated financial close for a client's finance automation programme. What you will work on Design the automated close in SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the close calendar. Automate balance sheet reconciliation, auto-certification, accruals and journal posting. Align the close design with SAP FI/CO. What you bring Hands-on design of an automated close in SAP Financial Closing cockpit, SAP AFC, BlackLine or Trintech Cadency. Balance sheet reconciliation, auto-certification, accruals and journal posting. SAP FI/CO. 8+ years' experience. Useful but not essential: Redwood Finance Automation or SAP CPS/BPA exposure. How to respond Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent close automation project: the close processes in scope, the tool and ERP it ran on, and which design decisions were yours. COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.



The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.



Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

 1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

 2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

 3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

 4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

jobs.title: Procurement Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Procurement Lead to own the commercial and vendor-management function for Supabase. You’ll run our cloud and SaaS vendor relationships end-to-end (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, CloudQuery, ClickHouse, and more), leading negotiations and renewals, enforcing procurement governance, and applying our VIA operating model (Visibility, Insights, Actions) to keep vendor spend disciplined and well-governed. You’ll work closely with Finance, Engineering, Legal, and our vendor partners.

This is a lead role for the Procurement function. The operating model, the source of truth for vendor spend, and the standards are yours to define, against a clear position: this is a FinOps role first, not a pure procurement desk. You'll own the technical and analytical side of vendor management, reporting, efficiency, and the commercial interface across the company, while keeping procurement governance tight. It's ideal for someone fluent across finance and engineering, who thrives in async, fast-moving environments, and wants to build a function from the ground up rather than inherit one.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:
